ambient_events: The infinity edge sheets over in a thin, endless film, whispering as it goes.
The fire-trough gutters and steadies against the rooftop wind.
description: The roof terrace down the west side of the Lantern, a hundred and fifteen metres over Marrow Street, behind a glass rail on a stone upstand. A lap pool runs along the middle of it, teak loungers beside it and a fire trough at the north end, where a white telescope stands at the rail. At the south end a striped awning in cream and cyan shades two teak benches and a table of cigars and cigarettes, with a set on the rail and the bar behind them. The Lantern is east.
name: Solenne Sky Deck
